title: The farrier’s
html_source: J. Kavanagh, horseshoer and farrier, 14-15 Beaver Street. [Gifford]

anchor.prefix: to take up his rather soapsuddy handkerchief after it had done yeoman service in the shaving line, they both walked together along Beaver street or, more properly, lane as far as
anchor.suffix: and the distinctly fetid atmosphere of the livery stables at the corner of Montgomery street where they made tracks to the left from thence debouching into Amiens street round by
